ledger.note: Searched for Buffalo Run with data centers and power demand. Targa's announcements describe a Permian connection between its Midland and Delaware systems for reliability and Waha access. No data center or power plant tie was found.
Searched for the Bull Run Extension with data centers and power demand. Targa describes a 43 mile Permian line for flow assurance to the Waha hub. No data center or power plant tie was found.

Checked trade press on Bull Run II and the ExxonMobil agreements. The line carries gas from three new Delaware Basin processing plants to Waha. Only general trade commentary on Permian gas and data centers turned up, and nothing about this project or a power plant it serves.

Forza was searched again together with the other Targa lines. The sources describe moving gas from the Red Hills plant to Wildcat Junction. No data center or power plant tie was found, and no named power plant customer was found.

Searched for Appalachia to Market III with data centers. Enbridge and the FERC notice describe supply for local gas utilities and industrial users. No named plant or data center load was found, and the utilities' own data center talk was not tied to this project.
Searched for Gillis West shippers, data centers, and power generation. Only a Transco outage notice and the blanket certificate notice turned up. No shipper plant or data center tie was found.
Searched for Traverse with data centers and power demand. Trade press describes a Gulf Coast supply link from Agua Dulce to Katy with investment grade shippers, and no data center or plant is named.
Searched for the Valley Crossing expansion with data centers. The expansion is a 2022 agreement to serve the Texas LNG export terminal in Brownsville, with no data center or power plant tie.
